definitions.explanation: A humble term used to refer to one's own company when speaking to clients, business partners, or other external parties. Standard in business correspondence and formal communication.

examples.japanese: {弊社|へいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for using our company's products.

examples.japanese: {弊社|へいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: Our company will begin a new service starting next month.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございましたら→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧、{弊社|へいしゃ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any questions, please contact our company.

notes:
USAGE:
A humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) term used exclusively in business contexts when referring to one's own company to outsiders. Essential in business emails, letters, and formal meetings. Never used for someone else's company.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: our company — neutral/formal, used in internal documents or press releases. Less humble than {弊社|へいしゃ}
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧: your company — the honorific counterpart, used when addressing someone else's company in writing
- ⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧: your company — honorific, used in formal writing (more formal than ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弊社|へいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (our company's products)
- {弊社|へいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (at our company)
- {弊社|へいしゃ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (to our company)
